Programs & Services

Build the Korea program your group needs.

Rather than selling one fixed product, we combine programs around your group's age, purpose, interests and schedule.

⌂

Homestay

Stay with a local family and experience everyday Korean life.

♡

Home Visit

Visit a Korean home for food, conversation and cultural exchange without an overnight stay.

宮

Cultural & Historical Tours

Palaces, hanok, markets, museums and living heritage with meaningful context.

✦

Hands-on Activities

K-pop dance, Korean cooking, Minhwa painting, taekwondo and more.

⇄

Youth Exchange

Peer exchange and shared activities with local youth.

Flexible study programs that connect learning goals with cultural immersion.

STEM

Explore Korean landscapes, ecology and local environments beyond the city.

For Buyers & Partners

Not a fixed package. A program we build together.

At KME, we want to work with inbound travel companies, schools, MICE planners, organizations and international partners to build the right program for each group. Select individual experiences or combine them into a complete itinerary.
